cells.description: Unprivileged host baseline for TT04: FS02/FS03 btrfs split+collision, FS09 real denials, FS10 ptrace audit, fork/exec/exit, same-owner concurrency, symlink-escape pinning and the calibration policy matrix run via cargo test --offline --locked -p scopebase-testkit --features linux-fixtures --test filesystem_cells with no manifest. Dynamic gates (btrfs-backed scratch, ptrace grant, non-root caller) report exact TT04-SKIP reasons in the test output.
cells.name: host-tt04-unprivileged

cells.description: Privileged host context for TT04: an explicit operator runs tools/qualification/provision_fs.py create --privileged (sudo -n grant, owned run-root only) and then the full filesystem_cells suite with TT04_MANIFEST set. Covers FS01 ext4 loop, FS04/FS05/FS06/FS07 overlays, FS08 foreign views + churn driver, NSpid and replaced-root sleepers. Full lifecycle verified; see docs/testing/filesystem-fixtures.md.
cells.name: host-tt04-provisioned

cells.description: Root-only ExactRange positive: exactly one cell (exact_range_positive_privileged) runs under sudo against the compiled test binary to exercise the map_files ExactRange route with real authority. The rest of the suite must stay unprivileged; root would vacate the FS09 DAC denials.
cells.name: host-tt04-exact-range
